items.headline: Nscale SEC filing discloses $103.4B in AI data-center contracts, anchored by Microsoft and Anthropic deals
items.why: Confirms scale of hyperscaler/AI-lab compute commitments to a neocloud ahead of its listing; signals capex backlog depth

items.headline: PBOC runs 700B yuan reverse repo, October net liquidity injection ~400B yuan, signaling shift to policy easing
items.why: Easing bias affects China growth/liquidity backdrop relevant to China AI and chip names

items.headline: China September new bank loans jump to 1.08T yuan ($161B), beating expectations
items.why: Credit data informs whether Beijing adds stimulus, shaping China AI/tech capex outlook

items.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang announces $2B in AI deals across Europe during tour, meets Macron
items.why: Shows Nvidia extending AI infrastructure commitments beyond US hyperscalers into sovereign/European buildouts

items.headline: China lets provinces draw on $82B in unspent bond quotas to shore up growth
items.why: Fiscal support signal for China growth and tech/AI capex ahead of Q3 GDP release

items.headline: OpenAI ARR disputed: Axios scoop said ~$70B (Sep 29); Bloomberg/FT report co. told investors ~$50B (Oct 8), $20B below earlier figure
items.why: Signals OpenAI growth narrative to investors may be inflated vs. Anthropic's comparable metric, pressuring IPO/funding valuation

items.headline: Fed releases September FOMC minutes: unanimous 25bp hike but deep split on further hikes; October hike odds fall below 22%
items.why: Shapes rate-cut/hike path and discount rate used to value long-duration AI growth stocks

items.headline: DeepSeek nears $12B+ funding round backed by Tencent and CATL ahead of 2027 IPO
items.why: Major capital infusion for China's leading open AI lab, intensifying US-China AI competition and compute buildout

items.headline: AI cloud/GPU neocloud Lambda raising up to $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation ahead of planned 2027 IPO
items.why: Signals continued investor appetite for GPU-cloud neoclouds amid hyperscaler AI capex boom; adds to IPO pipeline
